data.name: TCS_001
data.value: Is this...[pause=20] the summit?

data.name: TCS_002
data.value: The sky is so vast...[pause=15] We can see Metano from here.

data.name: TCS_003
data.value: You have climbed my tower.

data.name: TCS_004
data.value: I am Rayquaza.[pause=20] Keeper of the heavens.

data.name: TCS_005
data.value: For centuries I have watched the balance between earth and sky.

data.name: TCS_006
data.value: Why have you broken the seal of winds?

data.name: TCS_007
data.value: Rayquaza...[pause=15] His voice shakes the air!

data.name: TCS_008
data.value: We don't want to fight![pause=15] We seek the truth about the mist!

data.name: TCS_009
data.value: The mist...[pause=20] It reaches even here.

data.name: TCS_010
data.value: Something beneath the earth has ceased to sleep.[pause=15] I feel it in the currents.

data.name: TCS_011
data.value: You, small travelers,[pause=15] walk upon a rift that widens.

data.name: TCS_012
data.value: I cannot leave this summit.[pause=15] The sky holds me.

data.name: TCS_013
data.value: Then show me your wings are worth the wind that bears you.

data.name: TCS_014
data.value: If you stand after my storm,[pause=15] I will listen.

data.name: TCS_015
data.value: Brace yourselves, children of earth.

data.name: TCS_016
data.value: You endured.[pause=20] Few can.

data.name: TCS_017
data.value: Then I shall keep my part.[pause=15] Look to the sky!

data.name: TCS_018
data.value: Rayquaza inhales...[pause=30] the air tears!

data.name: TCS_019
data.value: HYPER BEAM!!!

data.name: TCS_020
data.value: The meteor...[pause=20] it shatters!

data.name: TCS_021
data.value: Incredible...[pause=15] He saved the world.[pause=20] In one breath.
